new_findings.title: F-14 lock-timeout fallback refreshes WITHOUT the lock: a slow (>10 s) or suspended lock holder plus one more tab waiting makes two tabs POST /refresh with the same refresh token -> identity revokes the whole family (reuse detection) -> every tab is logged out and clearSession() wipes the queue token + active hold mid-checkout
new_findings.evidence: Two module instances (vi.resetModules) share localStorage + a FIFO LockManager stub. (a) Tab A holds the lock, its /refresh response takes 12 s (server already rotated r1->r2 on arrival); tab B times out at 10 s and calls doRefresh unlocked with r1. Server log: ['refresh(r1) -> 200 r2', 'refresh(r1) -> 401 REUSE -> family revoked']. Tab B: AUTH_REQUIRED; tab B's 401 path (line 129) calls clearSession() BEFORE A's valid r2 lands, so tab A's doRefresh then throws 'Phien dang nhap da ket thuc'; getSession() === null; sessionStorage ef:queue:token:e1 and evenflow_hold_e1 are null. (b) Holder suspended (lock never granted), tabs B and C both time out, 200 ms RTT: ['refresh(r1) -> 200 r2', 'refresh(r1) -> 401 REUSE -> family revoked'], B:200 (holding a now-revoked r2 -> logged out at its next refresh), C:AUTH_REQUIRED. Backend: services/identity/internal/app/session.go:98-99 + domain ErrRefreshTokenReused -> revokeFamily. Round-1 X-10 was a hang; the fix converts it into a forced logout of all tabs whenever >=2 tabs wait on a slow/stuck holder (mobile networks, bfcache).
new_findings.fix: Never call doRefresh outside the lock. On timeout: (1) re-read storage and return the newer pair if another tab rotated; (2) otherwise request the lock again with `{ steal: true }` (the stuck holder loses it; stealers are still serialised among themselves) and run doRefresh inside that callback; keep a hard overall deadline that rejects with NETWORK_ERROR (not AUTH_REQUIRED, no clearSession) so the UI shows 'thử lại' instead of logging out. Additionally in the refresh-401 path (line 129) only clearSession when the problem is not a reuse-race, e.g. wait for a `storage` event / re-read storage after a short grace period before wiping, and do not wipe buy-flow keys on a refresh failure (only on explicit logout).

new_findings.title: F-1 quota-only mode covers ON_SALE only; SOLD_OUT is still fully blocked although the backend accepts a quota increase on SOLD_OUT and flips the event back to ON_SALE — the most common reason an organizer adds quota has no UI path (and page.test.tsx:96 locks the wrong behaviour in)
new_findings.evidence: canIncreaseTierQuota('SOLD_OUT') === false, canOpenEventEditor('SOLD_OUT') === false; EditEventPage with a SOLD_OUT event renders 'Không thể chỉnh sửa sự kiện' and no 'Số lượng vé' input; EventList/ModerationStatusCard therefore show no edit link. Backend services/event/internal/domain/event.go:157-161: `else if e.Status == StatusSoldOut { if newQuota > currentQuota { e.Status = StatusOnSale } }` and event_test.go:244 'SOLD_OUT mà tăng quota -> tự quay lại ON_SALE'. findings.json F-1 explicitly asked for '(and SOLD_OUT if the backend allows it)'.
new_findings.repro: it('SOLD_OUT blocked',async()=>{ expect(canIncreaseTierQuota('SOLD_OUT')).toBe(false); mocks.getById.mockResolvedValue(event('SOLD_OUT')); render(await EditEventPage({params:Promise.resolve({eventId:EVT})})); expect(await screen.findByText('Không thể chỉnh sửa sự kiện')).toBeInTheDocument(); expect(screen.queryByLabelText(/Số lượng vé/)).toBeNull(); });
new_findings.fix: canIncreaseTierQuota = state === 'ON_SALE' || state === 'SOLD_OUT'; validateTierQuotaUpdate should also block decreases for SOLD_OUT client-side (backend does not, quirk); update the quota-only header text and move SOLD_OUT from the blocked it.each to the quota-only expectation in edit/page.test.tsx and event-list.status.test.tsx.

new_findings.title: F-8 payment key is keyed by orderId only: after NETWORK_ERROR/AMBIGUOUS the user changes method or phone and the retry sends the OLD key with a NEW body -> gateway 422 idempotency-key-reused, surfaced verbatim as INVALID_INPUT 'Idempotency-Key da duoc dung cho mot yeu cau khac'; only the third click works
new_findings.evidence: Fake idem middleware (hash = method+path+identity+body, libs/go/idem/middleware.go:224). Attempt 1 (sandbox) reaches the server, response lost -> NETWORK_ERROR. Attempt 2 with method 'momo' -> same Idempotency-Key, 422 key-reused -> PaymentClientError INVALID_INPUT with the server's Vietnamese detail. Attempt 3 -> new key -> 200. Same with 503 then an edited phone number (Y-7b).
new_findings.repro: it('key reused after body change',async()=>{ let first=true; const server=idemServer(()=>json({payment_id:'p1',order_id:'o1',redirect_url:'/x',status:'PENDING'})); const {calls}=installFetch(async(c)=>{const res=await server(c); if(first){first=false; throw new TypeError('Failed to fetch');} return res;}); expect(code(await rejection(initiatePayment(PAY)))).toBe('NETWORK_ERROR'); const e2=await rejection(initiatePayment({...PAY,method:'momo'})); expect(code(e2)).toBe('INVALID_INPUT'); expect(msg(e2)).toMatch(/Idempotency-Key da duoc dung/); expect(calls[0].headers.get('Idempotency-Key')).toBe(calls[1].headers.get('Idempotency-Key')); });
new_findings.fix: Scope the stored key to the body: `ef:pay:{orderId}:{hash(method,buyer fields,amount)}` (or forget the key whenever the hook's formData changes), and map problem type `urn:eventflow:problem:idempotency-key-reused` to a one-time automatic rotate-and-resend instead of INVALID_INPUT.

new_findings.title: `inProgress` is computed inside the 409 loop and goes stale: 409 in-progress followed by a definitive 4xx (422/400/404) keeps the key in sessionStorage, contradicting the F-8 rule 'xoa khi thanh cong / loi dinh doat'; the next attempt (typically with a corrected body) reuses it -> Y-7 422 key-reused
new_findings.evidence: send #1 409 in-progress, send #2 422 amount-mismatch -> INVALID_INPUT; sessionStorage 'ef:pay:o1' still 'fd7cf78b-...'; send #3 with amount 200 carries the same Idempotency-Key as send #1. Control: a 422 without a preceding 409 forgets the key.
new_findings.repro: it('stale inProgress',async()=>{ vi.useFakeTimers(); let n=0; const {calls}=installFetch(()=>{n++; if(n===1) return json({type:IN_PROGRESS,title:'c',status:409,detail:'x'},409,{'Retry-After':'1'}); if(n===2) return problem(422,'/problems/amount-mismatch'); return json({payment_id:'p1',order_id:'o1',redirect_url:'/x',status:'PENDING'});}); const p=rejection(initiatePayment(PAY)); await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(2000); expect(code(await p)).toBe('INVALID_INPUT'); expect(sessionStorage.getItem('ef:pay:o1')).not.toBeNull(); await initiatePayment({...PAY,amount:200}); expect(calls[2].headers.get('Idempotency-Key')).toBe(calls[0].headers.get('Idempotency-Key')); });
new_findings.fix: Derive the flag from the FINAL response only: `const finalInProgress = response.status === 409 && (await readProblem(response)).type === IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS;` and use it in both the forgetKey condition and the AMBIGUOUS throw (hold-client already does this correctly at lines 181-187).

new_findings.title: F-3 retry mapping keeps the wizard's local tier id for a tier already created on the server, so the wizard still treats it as NEW (name/price editable, 'Xoá hạng vé' offered); editing it before retrying is silently dropped: no request carries the new name/price, no error, page navigates to review-status as if saved (same silent-field-loss class as X-7)
new_findings.evidence: Tiers #2 (created, srv-new-1) and #3 (failed). After the failure, step 2 shows tier #2 input disabled=false and 2 'Xoá hạng vé' buttons. Rename to 'VIP Renamed' + price 999000, Lưu nháp: addTier calls = ['Hạng vé #2','Hạng vé #3','Hạng vé #3'], updateQuota calls = [], router.push called; the review step displayed 'VIP Renamed: 999.000 đ — Quota: 100'. Removing tier #2 in the wizard would likewise leave it on the server.
new_findings.repro: it('rename dropped',async()=>{ let srvTier2=null; mocks.addTier.mockImplementationOnce(async(_e,t)=>(srvTier2={...t,id:'srv-new-1'})).mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('hạng 3 lỗi')).mockImplementation(async(_e,t)=>({...t,id:'srv-new-2'})); mocks.getById.mockImplementation(async()=>({...base,tiers:srvTier2?[...base.tiers,srvTier2]:base.tiers})); /* add 2 tiers, save -> 'hạng 3 lỗi' */ back(); back(); const tier2=screen.getAllByLabelText(/Tên hạng vé/)[1]; expect(tier2.disabled).toBe(false); fireEvent.change(tier2,{target:{value:'VIP Renamed'}}); next(); next(); fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button',{name:'Lưu nháp'})); await waitFor(()=>expect(mocks.push).toHaveBeenCalled()); expect(mocks.addTier.mock.calls.map(c=>c[1].name)).not.toContain('VIP Renamed'); expect(mocks.updateQuota).not.toHaveBeenCalled(); });
new_findings.fix: After addTier succeeds, replace the local tier in the wizard state with the server tier (expose an `onTierCreated(localId, serverTier)` prop or return the id map in WizardSubmitResult and let the wizard `setTiers` + extend existingTierIds), so created tiers become read-only (quota only) like initialEvent.tiers; alternatively key the wizard on the reloaded event so it re-initialises from server data.

new_findings.title: pairKey() embeds a raw NUL byte (0x00) in the template literal, so git classifies api-client.ts as binary ('Bin 7291 -> 9927 bytes' in the fix diff): the most security-sensitive file of the change cannot be reviewed in `git diff`/PR view, and grep -P/`file` choke on it
new_findings.evidence: `file apps/web/src/lib/api-client.ts` -> 'data'; `tr -d '\000' | wc -c` = 9926 vs 9927; `grep -a -n $'\x00'` -> line 102 `return \`${s.accessToken}^@${s.refreshToken ?? ""}\`;`; `git diff --numstat fa6ee8c 604d721 -- apps/web/src/lib/api-client.ts` -> `-	-`.
new_findings.repro: cd apps/web && file src/lib/api-client.ts && grep -a -c $'\x00' src/lib/api-client.ts && git diff --numstat fa6ee8c 604d721 -- src/lib/api-client.ts
new_findings.fix: Write the separator as an escape (`\u0000`) or use a printable separator such as `'|'`; the file also has CRLF line endings unlike the other new files, consider normalising.

checked_no_finding: Y-2 logout during in-flight refresh: client POSTs /logout with the consumed r1 only, but refresh_token_repo.go:110-115 RevokeFamilyByHash resolves family_id from the (retained) rotated row, so r2 is revoked server-side; not a finding.

Y-3 ef_expires_at missing/NaN/negative/far-future -> no proactive refresh (reactive 401 path handles); past -> one proactive refresh then the 30 s per-pair guard; refresh 5xx loop -> 1 refresh per 60 s window and the original request is still sent.
Y-4 retryAfterMs: HTTP-date -> 1000 ms, 999999999 -> 5000 ms cap, -5 -> 1000 ms, 0 -> 0 ms (3 immediate sends, bounded), 0.2 -> 200 ms.
409 retry cap: hold and payment both send at most 3 times then AMBIGUOUS; hold key forgotten after in-progress -> 422; quantity change gives a different hold key (no key-reused).
Lost 200 then retry with the same hold key: replay returns the (possibly expired) original hold, key is rotated after the 2xx so the next click gets a fresh hold.
Y-5 session epoch: logout + login as user B during user A's refresh -> A's result discarded, B's session intact (in-flight A request rejects AUTH_REQUIRED, acceptable).
Y-6 Google remember-me off with a stale localStorage session of another user -> localStorage wiped, Google pair (post device bind + refresh) lives in sessionStorage only.
clearSession() only wipes sessionStorage buy-flow prefixes; sessionStorage is per tab, so another tab's keys are untouched (but see Y-1 for the same tab being wiped by a refresh race).
REGISTERED_LOGIN_FAILED path, ON_SALE decrease blocked client-side, ON_SALE->SOLD_OUT flip between load and save (updateTierQuota still called), F-2 blockResubmit: behave as specified.
